title: Rerau language
text: The Rerau language (ISO 639-3: rea) is a threatened Papuan language of the Trans-New Guinea phylum, spoken primarily by the Rerau people in Astrolabe Bay, approximately 50 kilometers south of Madang Town in Madang Province, Papua New Guinea.
